'''Zephyr stealth suits''' were a common type of [[Stealth suit/Legends|stealth suit]] in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Used by urban vigilantes, criminals, and industrial [[Spy/Legends|spies]], Zephyrs were dark in [[Color/Legends|color]] with a matte-finish on all of its hardware. Equipped with [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a head garment covering everything but the wearer's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="EV" />
